name: knowledge-escrow
description: Your knowledge, held in escrow until the moment it's needed. Fully local, offline memory for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your knowledge, held in escrow until the moment it's needed
interface.longDescription: Knowledge Escrow quietly remembers the decisions, commitments, and people notes from your meetings and conversations, then surfaces them again exactly when you need them. Everything stays on your own computer — nothing is uploaded, and it works without an internet connection. Sensitive customer personal data (SSNs, account numbers, dates of birth, and similar) is automatically redacted before anything is saved.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next meeting
Capture the decisions and action items from these notes
